notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms row and a county index heading were found. The name 'berrien' matches the county name, and the tnlandforms note says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation, which this row (GA296) falls under, so the label may not be an official name. The tnlandforms list has two other Berrien County towers under different names (fulch and enigma?), so the row could be confused with them; the row's 'image?' note is unexplained. No history, staffing, fire or site description was found, and the status and access in the record are unverified. Unused lead: Berrien Historical Foundation (berriencountygeorgia.com/historical-society/), not fetched. Suggest Georgia Forestry Commission history staff for the BLL-65195 and gfc-811 files.
